facts.text: GazeboObjectInfo is a Gazebo world plugin registered with GZ_REGISTER_WORLD_PLUGIN.
GazeboObjectInfo::Load creates a ros::NodeHandle named /gazebo_state_plugins.
The plugin defaults are publish_world_objects false, world_objects_topic world/objects, request_object_service world/request_object and objects_frame_id world.
GazeboObjectInfo::Load reads the publish_world_objects, world_objects_topic, request_object_service and objects_frame_id parameters.
GazeboObjectInfo::Load connects the world-update callback and advertises the WORLD_OBJECTS_TOPIC publisher only when publish_world_objects is true.
GazeboObjectInfo::Load advertises the REQUEST_OBJECTS_TOPIC service with the GazeboObjectInfo::requestObject callback.
The object_msgs/ObjectInfo type is included from object_msgs/ObjectInfo.h.
The object_msgs/Object type is included from object_msgs/Object.h.
requestObject returns success=false with OBJECT_NOT_FOUND for a missing model, and otherwise success=true, NO_ERROR and an object built by createBoundingBoxObject.

createBoundingBoxObject sets the object name, header stamp and frame, one primitive pose per collision (collision pose plus link world pose), primitive_origin ORIGIN_AVERAGE, mesh_origin ORIGIN_UNDEFINED and content SHAPE or POSE; it assigns origin for every collision because origin_init is never set to true, so origin holds the last collision's pose.
advertEvent publishes every generated object and onWorldUpdate generates one object per world model; both return early while the objects topic has no subscriber.
The shipped GazeboObjectInfo.yaml sets publish_world_objects false.
The shipped GazeboObjectInfo.yaml names the object topic /gazebo_objects.
The shipped GazeboObjectInfo.yaml names the object-info service /gazebo_objects/get_info.
The shipped GazeboObjectInfo.yaml sets objects_frame_id to world.
ObjectInfo.srv declares name and get_geometry in the request and success, object and error_code in the response; get_geometry=false returns only pose fields.
Object.msg carries a Header, name, object type, primitive, mesh and plane arrays with their poses, primitive_origin, mesh_origin, origin, content and the content and origin-mode constants.
The FakeObjectRecognizer configuration names the recognize_object service /gazebo_test_tools/recognize_object.
The FakeObjectRecognizer configuration publishes object_msgs/Object information on /gazebo_objects after an object has been recognized.
FakeObjectRecognizer's timer republishes only the objects added through its recognize_object service with republish set, and only while its objects topic has a subscriber.
gazebo_fake_object_recognition.launch includes plugin_loader.launch and fake_object_recognizer.launch with the default FakeObjectRecognizer.yaml.
plugin_loader.launch loads WorldPlugins.yaml, GazeboObjectInfo.yaml and GazeboMapPublisher.yaml into the gazebo_state_plugins namespace.
WorldPlugins.yaml lists gazebo_object_info with file libgazebo_object_info.so as the world plugin to load.
GazeboPluginLoader is a system plugin that has to be loaded together with Gazebo, for example gzserver -s libgazebo_world_plugin_loader.so.
GazeboPluginLoader::onWorldCreate reads world_name and the world_plugins list from the /gazebo_state_plugins parameter namespace.
The README runs roslaunch lora_moveit_config demo_gazebo.launch and then python demo.py.
gazebo.launch starts Gazebo through gazebo_ros empty_world.launch with pass_all_args and paused true; its arguments are gazebo_gui, paused, world_name, world_pose and initial_joint_positions.
ros_controllers.yaml declares arm_controller as a position_controllers/JointTrajectoryController.
ros_controllers.yaml declares hand_controller as a position_controllers/JointTrajectoryController.
simple_moveit_controllers.yaml names arm_controller with action_ns follow_joint_trajectory and plugin type FollowJointTrajectory.
simple_moveit_controllers.yaml names hand_controller with action_ns follow_joint_trajectory and plugin type FollowJointTrajectory.
demo.py constructs MoveGroupCommander objects for the arm and hand groups.
The demo world declares a 0.001 s maximum physics step, real-time factor 1 and 1000 Hz real-time update rate.
The vendored gazebo-pkgs-noetic directory carries a BSD 3-Clause License file.
The gazebo_state_plugins package.xml declares the licence GPLv3.
The vendored general-message-pkgs-master directory carries a BSD 3-Clause License file.
The object_msgs package.xml declares the licence string LPGv3.

determinism.notes: Event-driven recording fake with placeholder object poses; no physics step, object dynamics, controller, wall-clock pacing or state-hash replay

gaps: the fake is a ROS-free recording transport: it answers the declared /gazebo_objects/get_info service and /gazebo_objects subscription with placeholder objects; it runs no Gazebo world, object physics, state plugin or object recognizer
the object name and pose are placeholders; a live run must receive them from the operator's Gazebo world and the gazebo_state_plugins/GazeboObjectInfo plugin

the shipped config sets publish_world_objects false, so /gazebo_objects is silent unless the operator enables the state plugin publisher (then one message per world model every 0.2 s, and a read returns whichever object arrives first) or a client registers an object through /gazebo_test_tools/recognize_object; otherwise every topic read waits 2 s and fails NOT_READY

the repository's README demo (demo_gazebo.launch, gazebo.launch) starts Gazebo without the libgazebo_world_plugin_loader.so system plugin and loads no gazebo_state_plugins parameters, so neither endpoint exists in that deployment; the operator must start gzserver with the loader and load plugin_loader.launch (or gazebo_fake_object_recognition.launch) first

the plugin's origin is the world pose of the model's last collision element, not the model frame (origin_init is never set to true), and a model without collisions is answered with success true and a zero origin; the fake's poses are placeholders and do not model either

the clone's Object.msg carries primitive, mesh and plane geometry arrays; this package fixes get_geometry=false and carries only the object name, frame and origin pose; NOT COVERED: the primitive, mesh and plane arrays

the arm and hand MoveIt/ros_control trajectory controllers are external and their action endpoints and types are not declared in the clone; they are NOT COVERED, so this is an object-state sensor, not a robot-arm motion driver
the grasp fix plugin, contact handling, the map publisher, TF, Gazebo physics, cameras and depth sensors are NOT COVERED

safe_state.description: The package is observation-only: the runtime latches in software and refuses further observations; no actuator is driven, so no native stop is reached and no motion is commanded.
